title: Beef and Bisque Stew
description: A hearty beef stew infused with the rich flavors of bisque, perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oozy butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the remaining 2 tbsp of oozy butter to the pot, then add the chopped onion.
Cook the onion until it's translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the Ukrainian bisque to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the beef to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
